CustomField.description:
Text formula that constructs a sentence explaining the relationship between the two Accounts
Caution: This field was installed from an Education Trailblazers Association solution. Before editing, ensure changes won't break automation.
CustomField.formula: Account.Name + " is the " + PartyRoleRelation.RoleName + " and " + RelatedAccount.Name + " is the " + PartyRoleRelation.RelatedRoleName
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A sentence that clarifies who's who in the Relationship.
CustomField.label: Relationship Explanation
